description: A thick, leather-bound field journal wrapped in silver wire.  Filled with decades of handwritten anatomical sketches, notes on vampire feeding patterns, the silver bane of werewolves, and coordinates to 'The Crimson Chalice' — a neutral ground bar protected by the ancient Accord of Sanctuary.  <color_light_green>(Read or activate to review your field notes.)</color>

use_action.description: Review your lifetime of vampire-hunting research.

description: A masterwork hunting crossbow customized with heavy recurve limbs, rapid-draw pulley mechanisms, and engraved silver inlays along the stock.  Tuned for lethal accuracy and swift reloads when hunting creatures of the night.

A heavy crossbow bolt turned from consecrated mountain ash wood, scored with silver-plated spiral grooves and tipped with a hardened steel-chisel point.  Designed to penetrate thick hides and deliver catastrophic shock to vampire hearts.

A heavy mountain-ash crossbow bolt tipped with a hardened steel-chisel head and an incendiary core of white phosphorus and silver shavings.  Ignites on impact to scorch undead flesh and suppress regeneration.

A masterwork crossbow bolt turned from consecrated mountain ash and crowned with a razor splinter of ancient white oak.  Imbued with primal eldritch magic, it delivers devastating piercing power and serves as the sole weapon in existence capable of extinguishing an Original vampire.

A heavy combat trench knife forged from folded tool steel with a mirror-finished sterling silver edge and consecrated crucifix engraving on the ricasso.  Balanced for devastating close-quarters combat against werewolves, severing lycanthropic sinew with toxic silver burn.

A long, triangular-bladed dueling rapier forged from folded spring steel and electroplated in consecrated silver.  Designed for rapid, pinpoint thrusts straight into a werewolf's vitals, delivering agonizing silver burns past dense beast muscle.
A heavy throwing dagger forged in the shape of a willow leaf from solid silver alloy.  Balanced for silent, long-range throwing into werewolves and feral shapeshifters.

A floor-length hunter's duster tailored from heavyweight oilskin leather, reinforced with multi-layered ballistic aramid and silver-threaded lining.  Features internal quick-draw holsters, bandolier loops for bolts, and superior weather insulation.

A custom-fitted armored vest worn beneath Van Helsing's duster.  Constructed from hardened cuir-bouilli leather interlined with multi-layer ballistic aramid and a fine weave of consecrated silver mail over the chest.  It specifically protects the heart and vitals against crushing claws, fangs, and piercing weapons.

Heavyweight cargo trousers tailored from tear-resistant ballistic canvas, featuring padded leather knee inserts and concealed aramid reinforcement to protect against low sweeping claw strikes and bites.
Hardened leather gauntlets lined with cut-resistant aramid weave and silver-riveted knuckles.  Designed to withstand bites from unliving jaws when grappling or parrying.
Heavy, knee-high combat boots reinforced with a puncture-proof steel shank in the sole, treated oilskin leather, and aramid padding around the ankles to resist venomous bites, glass, and snare wire.
A heavy cross-chest leather bandolier custom-stitched with loops for crossbow bolts, holy water phials, and silver throwing stakes.

A dark, weather-worn felt slouch hat with a wide downward brim, lined with an internal ballistic aramid skull-cap and hardened leather band.  It protects the head against predatory bites, acid drippings from crypt ceilings, and blunt trauma.

A heavy medallion of blackened silver bearing the seal of an overflowing chalice flanked by crossed stakes.  Possession of this token signifies accredited standing under the Accord of Sanctuary: you are recognized as a peaceful patron at The Crimson Chalice bar.

A heavy, dark glass bottle sealed with red wax.  Inside is a fortified blend of donor blood, rare elderberry wine, and botanical stabilizers.  Brewed specifically to nourish vampires and alleviate their blood hunger without bloodshed.  <color_light_green>(Drink to quench vampiric hunger.)</color>

A medical-grade pouch containing refrigerated synthetic plasma infused with iron salts, glucose, and botanical nutrients.  Served behind the bar at the Crimson Chalice for patrons seeking clean blood sustenance.  <color_light_green>(Drink to quench vampiric hunger.)</color>

A potent herbal spirit distilled behind the Crimson Chalice bar by Father Michael.  Infused with rye whiskey, bitter orange, and consecrated valerian root.  <color_light_green>(Drink to steady your nerves and banish fear.)</color>

A velvet-black fortified cordial prepared by Lady Seraphina for aristocratic kindred.  Rich in dark berry essence, spices, and concentrated vitae.  <color_light_green>(Drink to quench vampiric hunger.)</color>
A silver crucifix pendant etched with the initials 'C.M.'  Worn by Gideon Graves' apprentice Cole, who disappeared while scouting a feral vampire crypt.
A small brass tin filled with a pungent, astringent paste made of pressed wild garlic, powdered mountain ash, and consecrated oils.  <color_light_green>(Activate to apply warding balm.)</color>

use_action.description: Rub the warding paste onto your collar and wrists.

description: A dense cylinder of white chalk ground from limestone and river silt, infused with consecrated holy water.  Used to draw sacred warding geometry across thresholds.  <color_light_green>(Activate to inscribe warding threshold.)</color>

use_action.description: Draw sacred geometric runes across the doorway.

description: A sealed glass phial wrapped in silver filigree containing water blessed according to ancient rites.  <color_light_green>(Activate to drink and sanctify your mind.)</color>

A heavy handheld flare tube packed with high-grade magnesium, sulfur, and concentrated phosphor salts.  Striking the primer generates an intense, blinding burst of ultraviolet radiation that mimics high-noon solar illumination, repelling creatures of the night.

use_action.msg: You strike the magnesium striker!  A blinding white-hot flare of UV solar light ignites with an intense hiss!

description: A blinding white magnesium flare burning with intense ultraviolet radiation.  The brilliance forces shadow-dwelling predators to recoil and illuminates the darkest crypts.
revert_msg: The magnesium sun-flare sputters out into cold ash.

description: An exquisite, priceless medieval signet ring forged from consecrated sterling silver and crowned with a celestial lapis lazuli gem.  Blessed with lunar eclipse warding rituals, it protects kindred from the searing combustion of solar rays.  Virtually unobtainable in the ruins; only ancient vampire nobility and master purveyors possess one.

A medical-grade vacuum-sealed IV pouch of stabilized Type-O blood plasma treated with cold anti-coagulants and sorcerous preservatives.  An indispensable lifeline for kindred in hiding or civilized vampires unwilling to feed on living thralls.  <color_light_green>(Use to drink.)</color>

use_action.description: Drink the preserved donor plasma pouch.

description: A heart-seeking hunting stake carved from ancient mountain ash wood, fitted with an intricately spiraled sterling silver tip and anointed with consecrated sanctum oil.  Deadly against nightstalkers, ghouls, and undead fiends.

A heavy, ornate chalice of blackened repousse silver with Bohemian ruby glass inlays along the stem.  Used in vampire enclaves to serve Crimson Vintage and vintage blood draughts in refined aristocratic ceremonies.

name.str: reliquary of the white oak splinter

description: An ancient, heavy lead reliquary sealed with blackened wax and inscribed with Norse warding runes.  Inside rests an authentic, petrified splinter of the ancient White Oak Tree — the only substance capable of permanently slaying an Original vampire.

A heavy leather-bound grimoire penned a thousand years ago by Esther Mikaelson, mother of the Originals.  Its vellum pages hum with dark psychic witchcraft and ancient binding spells that unsettle the minds of vampires nearby.
A talisman carved from petrified werewolf bone and strung on woven leather cord, given by Niklaus Mikaelson.  It carries the scent of wild woods and radiates fierce predator vigor.

name.str: heirloom signet of the noble house

description: A masterfully engraved signet ring of fine sterling silver bearing the crest of Elijah Mikaelson.  Given as a token of an unbreakable oath kept, it steadies the wearer's nerves and commands respect.

An alchemical philter distilled from the ancient witch's cure of the Sleeper, bound with consecrated mountain ash and distilled holy water.  When ingested or coated upon silver weaponry, it suppresses vampiric cell regeneration and anchors immortal essence back to mortality.

A precision handloaded 9x19mm cartridge featuring a solid sterling silver hollow-point projectile engraved with microscopic crucifix runes.  Engineered specifically to counter werewolves and lycanthropic shapeshifters, delivering lethal silver shock that sears beast flesh and suppresses werewolf regeneration.

A heavy-hitting .45 ACP cartridge tipped with a solid cast silver bullet etched with the cross of the Inquisitor Order.  Delivers colossal stopping power against werewolves and lupine abominations, shattering predatory bone and inflicting devastating silver trauma.

A heavy 12-gauge magnum shotgun shell loaded with 8 pellets of hand-cast consecrated silver alloy.  Deadly at close range against werewolves and rogue beasts, tearing through thick pelt and burning lycanthropic flesh with silver shock.

A customized 12-gauge rifled sabot slug packed with a stabilized magnesium-silver core and phosphor salts.  Upon firing, the round ignites into blinding ultraviolet solar incandescence, punching through heavy armor and igniting vampires with intense artificial daylight.

A silent mountain-ash hunting arrow tipped with a broadhead forged from consecrated sterling silver and etched with warding glyphs.  The ultimate silent weapon against werewolves, piercing deep into beast hides and stopping lycanthropic regeneration in its tracks.

A dense, seasoned hardwood stake carved down to a sharp tapered point.  The signature weapon of vampire hunters: light, swift, and designed to impale an unliving heart and disrupt unholy regeneration with splintering strikes.  Flimsy upon hard armored impacts.

A square amber crystal decanter filled with smooth small-batch Kentucky bourbon steeped with wild purple vervain.  Damon Salvatore's signature pour.  Grants mortals sharp clarity and mental protection against unholy hypnosis, but sears vampiric flesh like boiling acid.  <color_light_green>(Drink for mental resolve; harmful to vampires.)</color>

An antique, 140-proof emerald spirit distilled from mountain grand wormwood, fennel, and star anise.  Favored by the Mikaelson family and Victorian immortals during their wildest binges.  Extremely potent, providing deep euphoria, pain suppression, and heightened senses.

A heavy, golden wild-honey mead brewed by the Crimson werewolf pack using mountain clover and alpine spring water.  Thick, warming, and invigorating, favored by shapeshifters and northern hunters after a long hunt.

A mythical black-crimson vintage bottled before the fall of the French monarchy and aged in charred ash casks.  Fortified with elder vitae and rare winter truffles.  Considered the crown jewel of Lord Cassian's private cellar.  <color_light_green>(Drink to quench vampiric hunger.)</color>

The blackened, calcified heart torn straight from the chest cavity of a destroyed vampire.  It radiates an unnatural chill and will never decay, preserved eternally by dark vitae.  A prized trophy and invaluable occult catalyst.

A precision handloaded 9x19mm cartridge fitted with a lathe-turned oak bullet, inspired by the vampire hunter armories of Mystic Falls.  While less effective against metal body armor, the projectile shatters inside unliving flesh, embedding jagged splinters that aggressively suppress vampire regeneration.

A heavy .45 ACP round tipped with a solid carved white-ash projectile.  Delivers punishing close-range impact and fractures into fragments on bone, halting unholy regeneration in vampires and sapping their supernatural agility.

A devastating 12-gauge shotshell loaded with a heavy cylindrical slug of compressed, flame-cured oak.  A brutal tool of the modern hunter, dealing heavy blunt-piercing trauma and saturating a vampire's torso with regeneration-stalling wood shards.

An exquisite heavy vellum parchment sealed with crimson wax bearing the crest of the Crimson Chalice.  The elegant calligraphy reads:

'To the wanderers of the night—by decree of the Accord of Sanctuary, weapons are sheathed and ancient feuds suspended at the hearth of the Crimson Chalice.  Vintages poured for the living and unliving alike.  Follow the bearings inscribed within.'

Reading or activating it marks the sanctuary location on your overmap.

use_action.message: You break the crimson wax seal, decipher the bearings, and mark the Crimson Chalice on your overmap.

description: An exquisite European dueling rapier forged before the cataclysm, carried by the arrogant vampire duelist Corvin.  Its swept silver basket hilt and perfectly balanced folded-steel blade allow lightning-fast lunges, ripostes, and deadly puncturing precision.

A handwritten dark grimoire bound in treated hide and inscribed in dark ink and dried blood, belonging to the hedge witch Morrigan.  It contains forbidden alchemical formulas for boiling the blood of vampires, boundary hexes, and protective vervain distillations.
A heavy solid silver medallion bearing the stamped insignia of a burning blade clutched in an armored gauntlet.  Carried by commanding officers of the Silver Hand hunter sect as proof of authority.
A bloodstained tactical map marked with the hidden GPS coordinates of a Silver Hand emergency supply depot buried near the highways.

use_action.message: You decipher the encrypted grid coordinates and mark the Silver Hand outpost on your overmap.
